data.name: NECROSYNTEX
data.detailed_description:
NecroSyntex is a 3D co-op third-person shooter set in a near-future apocalyptic world.
In an age where medical technology had reached unprecedented heights, a mysterious new drug spread across the globe—turning humans into horrifying mutant creatures.
Now, the last survivors must rely on the same dangerous drugs, known as Doping, to gain the strength needed to fight back.

As a special operative, you and up to three teammates are deployed into infested zones to complete missions, eliminate threats, and ultimately escape alive.

Key Features

  • 4-Player Online Co-op
    Play solo or team up with friends. Coordination and teamwork are the keys to survival.

  • Doping System: Power at a Price

    • 12 unique doping abilities across Offensive, Defensive, and Utility categories

    • Choose 2 before each mission, regardless of category

    • Can be used on yourself or allies — buffs and debuffs apply to both (strategic play or even trolling possible)

  • Four Playable Characters
    Each with unique stats and a special Constitution passive that grants extra effects when using doping (without suffering additional debuffs).

  • Mission-Based Gameplay
    Defend objectives, survive against waves, secure targets, and more — each mission offers new challenges beyond simple combat.

  • High Risk, High Reward

    • Fail a single mission, and it’s game over.

    • If all players die, the operation ends.

    • Friendly fire enabled — allies can be harmed, so think twice before pulling the trigger.

  • Controls & Customization
    The game is played with keyboard (WASD for movement, R to reload, etc.) and mouse (aiming and shooting).
    Key bindings are fully customizable through the in-game settings, allowing you to adapt the controls to your playstyle.

Summary

In a world ravaged by a mysterious drug that spawned countless mutants, you are a soldier enhanced by dangerous doping effects.
Together with your squad, you must complete missions and fight your way to survival.
But remember: every dose of power comes with a price.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains frequent violence and gore. Players will engage in combat against infected creatures (mutant) using a variety of firearms weapons.

The game also features a horror setting with dark environments and sudden enemy appearances that may be frightening to some players.
